item.tarbound.votive_rack.tip: Light it within 3 blocks of a radio: more jobs at once and deeper orders while it burns. A Votive Skull set on it reaches 5.
item.tarbound.weeping_seep.tip: Touching a radio's tar or antennas, it weeps cheap filler (cobblestone, sand, sugar cane, string, spider eyes...) into that radio's jobs and orders when storage runs short, for a little Spirit each. Never into storage, never for players.
item.tarbound.bottomless_seep.tip: Creative: touching the tar, it hands its radio endless raw materials (anything no contract on that radio makes, items and fluids). Everything else still gets crafted, so orders run their whole tree. For testing deep orders.
tarbound.ponder.tar_pool.text_1: Black tar binds every inventory it touches into one shared pool
tarbound.ponder.tar_pool.text_2: Chests, barrels and other storage touching the tar join the pool
tarbound.ponder.tar_pool.text_3: A Scrying Font within 3 blocks of the tar reads the whole pool
tarbound.ponder.tar_pool.text_4: Open it to search, take and insert items from every bound inventory at once
tarbound.ponder.tar_pool.text_5: A crafting table touching the tar unlocks the radio's crafting grid
tarbound.ponder.tar_antenna.text_1: Tar Antennas link inventories to a Scrying Font without running tar to them
tarbound.ponder.tar_antenna.text_2: Shift-right-click the radio with antennas in hand to tune the whole stack to it
tarbound.ponder.tar_antenna.text_3: Mount a tuned antenna on any face of an inventory: whatever touches the antenna joins the pool
tarbound.ponder.tar_antenna.text_4: The radio reaches any tuned antenna within 3 blocks of it
tarbound.ponder.tar_antenna.text_5: Tar, crafting tables and inventories touching any piece of an antenna count as touching the tar
tarbound.ponder.antenna_range.text_1: One piece makes rabbit ears, with 3 blocks of reach. This barrel is too far from the radio to link
tarbound.ponder.antenna_range.text_2: Two pieces make a rooftop aerial: 6 blocks. An antenna doesn't need an inventory; on bare ground it just relays
tarbound.ponder.antenna_range.text_3: The ears and the aerial link: two antennas connect when they're within the larger of their two reaches
tarbound.ponder.antenna_range.text_4: Three pieces make a broadcast mast: 9 blocks. Place antennas onto an antenna to stack it, up to three
tarbound.ponder.antenna_range.text_5: Now the chain reaches the radio: tower, aerial, ears. The barrel joins the pool
tarbound.ponder.antenna_range.text_6: Distance is measured between the mounted ends, and every antenna in the chain must be tuned to the same radio
tarbound.ponder.antenna_modes.text_1: An antenna's mode decides how the radio may use the inventories it touches
tarbound.ponder.antenna_modes.text_2: Commune (red): the radio takes from it and stores into it, the same as touching tar
tarbound.ponder.antenna_modes.text_3: Right-click with an empty hand to change mode. Scry (gold): the radio sees and takes, but never stores. For output chests
tarbound.ponder.antenna_modes.text_4: Tithe (violet): the radio stores into it, but can't see or take it back. For feed and void chests
tarbound.ponder.antenna_modes.text_5: Shift-right-click with an empty hand to set a priority from -99 to 99: higher fills first and empties last
tarbound.ponder.antenna_modes.text_6: At the same priority, a Tithe inventory only gets what visible storage can't hold
tarbound.ponder.reliquary.text_1: Machines don't join the pool by touching tar: their slots would mix with your storage
tarbound.ponder.reliquary.text_2: Tune a Reliquary to the radio with a shift-right-click, like an antenna
tarbound.ponder.reliquary.text_3: Set it on top of a machine. The machine is bound to that radio from anywhere in the dimension, while both are loaded
tarbound.ponder.reliquary.text_4: Bound machines appear in the radio's machine window, slot by slot, to load and empty from there
tarbound.ponder.reliquary.text_5: Its spirit keeps a bound furnace lit with no fuel while there is something to cook, paid for in the radio's Spirit
tarbound.ponder.reliquary.text_6: Once a second, finished products drain out of bound machines into the pool
tarbound.ponder.reliquary.text_7: Toss it a gold nugget and its spirits hoard what lands nearby: other mods' magnets can't take it. Again to let go
tarbound.ponder.reliquary.text_8: Name a Reliquary in an anvil, or at the top of its screen, to tell look-alike machines apart
tarbound.ponder.contracts.text_1: A Spirit Contract tells a machine spirit what one operation takes in and gives back
tarbound.ponder.contracts.text_2: Put blank contracts in the Scribing Lectern's left slot
tarbound.ponder.contracts.text_3: With the lectern open, find a recipe in JEI or EMI and press + to lay it out (or drag items in), then press Write. The contract appears in the right slot
tarbound.ponder.contracts.text_4: Give the contract to the Reliquary on the machine that runs it. Feed it candles to open more contract slots
tarbound.ponder.contracts.text_5: In the radio, anything a contract can make has a cyan mark. Click a dimmed ghost, or Ctrl-click an item, to order an amount
tarbound.ponder.contracts.text_6: The job loads the machine from the pool a few operations at a time, and counts the products as they come back
tarbound.ponder.contracts.text_7: Every Reliquary holding the same contract shares the job, so more machines finish sooner
tarbound.ponder.contracts.text_8: Jobs run with the screen closed and are saved with the world. Watch or cancel them in the radio's second tab
tarbound.ponder.crafting_station.text_1: A tuned Reliquary on a crafting table makes a crafting station
tarbound.ponder.crafting_station.text_2: Give it a contract written from a crafting recipe. It has no slots: it takes the ingredients from the pool and puts the result back
tarbound.ponder.crafting_station.text_3: Stations holding the same contract split a job evenly: two tables craft twice as fast
tarbound.ponder.crafting_station.text_4: If the pool has no room for the result, stations wait instead of crafting, and the job says Pool full
tarbound.ponder.standing_contracts.text_: A standing contract keeps a machine fed with anything in an item tag, with no job to order
Leave a one-input contract in the lectern's right slot, pick one of its item's tags with < and >, and press Generalize
In a Reliquary, it loads every matching item in the pool into the machine, keeping a small buffer topped up
Requested jobs get first pick. Pause or resume standing contracts in the lower half of the radio's jobs tab
tarbound.ponder.spirit_board.text_1: A Spirit Board opens a radio's screen from afar
tarbound.ponder.spirit_board.text_2: Shift-right-click the radio to tune the board to it
tarbound.ponder.spirit_board.text_3: Then right-click anywhere in the same dimension: the pool, crafting grid, machines and jobs, all there
tarbound.ponder.spirit_board.text_4: The radio's chunk must be loaded. Past your view distance, keep it loaded with a chunk loader
tarbound.ponder.feeding_spirits.text_1: A radio's automation runs on Spirit, held in a store you can see on its screen. Storage itself is always free
tarbound.ponder.feeding_spirits.text_2: Right-click the radio with candles to feed the spirits
tarbound.ponder.feeding_spirits.text_3: Hoppers and pipes can feed candles straight in. The radio takes nothing else, and gives nothing back
tarbound.ponder.feeding_spirits.text_4: With the candle on its screen lit, the radio burns candles kept in the pool whenever Spirit runs below half
tarbound.ponder.feeding_spirits.text_5: Loading machines, crafting at stations, Spirit Fire, machine power and Spirit Boards spend it. Out of Spirit, they wait
tarbound.ponder.feeding_spirits.text_6: A comparator reads how full the store is, to sound an alarm or start a candle line
tarbound.ponder.tag.tarbound.description: Tar pools, haunted radios and machine spirits

gui.tarbound.steward.keep_hint: How many of the selected row to keep. Shift-click a button for ten times as much
gui.tarbound.steward.status.short: Storage is short of what it takes to make
gui.tarbound.steward.status.no_contract: No contract on this radio makes this
gui.tarbound.steward.status.no_slot: Waiting for a free job slot on the radio
gui.tarbound.steward.status.order_busy: Waiting: it watches one order with sub-crafts at a time
gui.tarbound.steward.status.too_big: Too big to plan: more steps than it can watch, or past the radio's planning limit
